_comment: UNVERIFIED: matched on the simulator's title by these fragments. The rotorcraft variables this program reads (collective, rotor RPM, brakes, clutch, pedals, governor target) are the generic MSFS helicopter variables; whether each add-on publishes them is not measured. Until it is, the checks on them are off for this model; a pilot's own file may check them again.
source: Asobo Airbus H125 (and H130/H125 family titles): no measurement; UNVERIFIED as above.
